title: Beef Pot Roast with Gravy

items: few twigs of rosemary and thyme
1 tsp salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika (each)
1 tbsp ketchup, brown sugar, soy sauce (each)
2 tbsp apple vinegar or white wine

instructions: Preheat oven to 163C if using oven, but Remoska is fine.
Cut beef into reasonably sized chunks, season it with mix and sear it on a pan.
Remove it from pan and add diced onion and a pinch of salt.
Once at least translucent, add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for about 3 minutes while stirring.
Deglaze with red wine or wine substitution.
Let simmer for a while to reduce the alcohol.
Braising time: put the sauce and the meat into Remoska or oven dish and add bay leaves, rosemary, and thyme.
Add as much beef broth to cover the meat at least midway, but ideally about 70%.
Midway the braising, add plenty of chopped up carrots. Add more than you might think is right.
Continue baking until its super tender and fall apart. Usually at least 4-6 hours, but depends on the cut of meat. Do rotate it once in a while so the top doesnt burn.
Once done, remove the meat and chunks of carrots from the pot. Add some flour and mix it into thicker gravy. Add butter if desired. Season to taste with pepper and salt if needed.
Return the beef and carrots back, and ready to serve with some mashed creamy potatoes.
